now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
now.text: Freed from the Collector's museum, Howard the Duck sips a drink with Cosmo.

proposed.text: After the Collector's museum is wrecked, Howard the Duck sits unharmed in his broken case, sipping a drink beside the Collector and Cosmo.

changes.evidence: In the Guardians of the Galaxy post-credits scene Howard is still inside the ruined museum, undamaged in his broken containment cell, drinking while Tivan sits nearby and Cosmo licks Tivan's face. He has not left the museum ('freed from' it), and he is with the Collector as well as Cosmo. He is next seen away from it on Contraxia in Vol. 2.

now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
now.text: Nebula, a Luphomoid, says Thanos replaced her body with machine parts each time she lost to Gamora.

proposed.text: Nebula says Thanos replaced her body with machine parts each time she lost to Gamora.

changes.evidence: 'Luphomoid' comes from the official Guidebook to the MCU, not from anything said or shown in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 (the wiki cites only the guidebook for the name). The rest of the record matches the film: Nebula tells Kraglin that Thanos replaced a piece of her with machinery every time Gamora beat her. The file's own name also uses the label, which is the owner's call.

now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
now.text: Lylla befriends young Rocket in the High Evolutionary's lab and is killed as they try to escape.

changes.evidence: Lylla is killed in the High Evolutionary's lab (Arête Laboratories) during Batch 89's escape, years before the film's present. Batch 89 is told it is going to the 'new world', Counter-Earth, which does not exist yet, so the lab is not on Counter-Earth. The right place is the High Evolutionary's lab, and the app's places don't seem to include it. Floor's and Teefs's records for the same scene already use at: [].

now.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
now.text: Ayesha sends Adam Warlock after Rocket for the High Evolutionary.

changes.evidence: The planet Sovereign does not appear in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3. Ayesha's only scene about the hunt for Rocket is in the Arête Laboratories hangar on Counter-Earth: Adam returns wounded and the High Evolutionary orders her to bring him 89P13 or he will destroy the Sovereign. She then goes to the Orgoscope and on to Counter-Earth.
